description:
Get Airbnb Property Details

Fetches the full Airbnb property page by listing URL. Returns title, description, location, coordinates, rating and review count, host profile, room/bed/bath counts, photos, and amenities list. Use for travel-planning agents, deep-dive rate research, photo/amenity enrichment of listings discovered via the listing-search endpoint, and LSTR compliance or market-quality audits.

url.description: The URL of the Airbnb listing. Must be a valid Airbnb listing URL.
